arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Taking or dealing damage in Werebear form grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}Stoicism{/c}, ({c_number}[2]{/c} while {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}) which increases your damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c}. Stacks up to {c_number}[Affix_Value_2]{/c} times and lasts {c_number}15{/c} seconds.
